content: ACE-Step install paths verified from official GitHub READMEs: ACE-Step 1.5 (github.com/ACE-Step/ACE-Step-1.5) installs via git clone + uv sync (or pip install -e .); REST API server launches with 'uv run acestep-api' and serves on http://localhost:8001 by default (matches ACESTEP_BASE_URL default); Gradio UI via 'uv run acestep' on :7860; API auth via --enable-api --api-key KEY --port 8001. Models auto-download to ./checkpoints on first run (main model bundle: vae, Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B, acestep-v15-turbo, acestep-5Hz-lm-1.7B) or pre-download via python -m acestep.model_downloader. Python 3.11-3.12 recommended for the SERVICE environment (separate venv from studio). Legacy ACE-Step v1 is pip-installable as 'ace-step' on PyPI but that is the OLD model line.
